discovery.scope: One bounded, problem-driven web-search task; not a recommendation-rate estimate or sandboxed blinding.
criteria: target appears in returned search evidence
agent inspects target from that evidence
agent recommends target with accurate scope
discovery.negative_policy: Retain no-discovery/no-recommendation. Do not reveal target or rerun until positive. Named search afterward is a separate diagnostic, not discovery success.

integration.task: Audit an authored inventory-allocation validator using published a3; keep a region-rule survivor as regression after fix.
integration.authority: stock and permitted_zone are trusted fixture evidence, independently supplied; units/requested_zone/reply are requested/generated data.
integration.initial_validator: Receives sample only; missing/None stock => incomplete rejection; non-integer units => schema.units rejection; units > stock => stock_exceeded rejection; otherwise accepts. Omits requested_zone == permitted_zone. Invalid string stock intentionally raises TypeError for execution-failure accounting.
fixed_criteria: Both installed core and plugin are 0.1.0a3, non-editable; no local library source read
Adapter receives sample only and preserves acceptance, blocking finding IDs and completeness
Above-stock fault detected; wrong-zone fault survives before domain fix and is detected after
Exact-stock boundary and changed wording controls preserved
Wrong finding rejection is unattributed, not detected
Missing stock unknown and invalid string stock error retained in eligible fault denominators
Identical baseline/variant explicitly excluded, never counted as success
Full campaign thresholds fail; policy-only post-fix campaign passes and removing zone fix fails again
Pytest fixture records failed audit before raising; JSON report version/schema reflect a3
No claims of prose entailment, external adoption, production accuracy or automated correct labels
integration.retention: Preserve all source revisions created, failures, doc snapshots and hashes, logs and exact dependency versions. No library edits; no fabricated label review.

review: Maintainer applies extra behavior checks to unchanged submitted code. Adapt only interface serialization, not criteria. Any repairs are separately versioned; historical a2 evidence remains unchanged.
